category_title: Hospitalized youth with mental disorders exhibiting radical mood swings and behavioral instability
scenario_title: Creative Art Work and Psychological Expression
minimal_context: The student is continuing a long-term drawing project during an art lesson in class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's continue with your creative art work today. You can keep working on your drawing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm making this drawing about my psychological issues. It shows how my inner world is stormy and complicated.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I've been working on this long process of creative art work for weeks, but my mood is starting to swing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do what you can with it right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I'm suddenly in a really bad mood. I'm abruptly throwing it away!
